pred_visual.meaning: one propagated current feature per arm

predictor_input.meaning: actual model.encode output supplied to predictor

quant_snapshot.keying: top-level modules dictionary keyed by complete encoder Linear module path, sorted lexicographically

per_module.fp: CPU float32 tensor with original weight shape
per_module.codes: CPU int8 tensor [4, *weight_shape], order RTN, SR0, SR1, SR2
per_module.readback_sha256: four actual RTN/SR0/SR1/SR2 writeback hashes in the same order
per_module.restore_sha256: actual restored FP32 weight hash, stored separately from readback_sha256

quantization.scale: CPU torch.float32 max_abs_per_output_row / float32(7), zero row scale 1
quantization.sr: floor(v)+1[U < v-floor(v)], clipped to [-7,7], CPU torch.float32
quantization.traversal: full module name lexicographic order; one torch.rand(weight.shape, float32) per module per draw
